messages:
maria: FYI incoming intake for Zephyr-14B (open checkpoint). Customer wants lower streaming latency and reliable tool-calls for QA chat.

alex: Got it. Which workloads and SLAs?

maria: High-volume QA chat + embeddings. Needs streaming, tool-driven lookups, and exact JSON outputs for downstream parsing.

jiang: Plan: baseline vs our 13B-int8 profile, then quant experiments. Focus on latency and JSON fidelity.

sam: Initial test matrix:
- hardware: 1xA100 vs 2xA10
- quant: int8, awq-4, int4 variants
- e2e chat templates with tool schemas

taylor: Prompt template for tool call (enforce strict JSON):

```
System: You are a structured assistant. Respond with either {"response_type":"final_answer","payload":{...}} or {"response_type":"tool_call","payload":{"tool":"...","args":{...}}}.
User: {{input}}
Assistant:
```

maria: Add top-level enum 'response_type' and require args to be objects. Also note streaming semantics.

alex: Test cases to include:
1) direct QA -> expect final_answer
2) dataset search -> expect tool_call then final_answer
3) invalid JSON -> fail

jiang: I'll wire an eval harness with token-latency logging and exact-match checks for tool args.

sam: Metrics to capture: p50/p95 token latency, tokens/sec, JSON exact-match, semantic score (BERTScore).

taylor: For quant runs run AWQ and int8; watch for formatting regressions even if semantic scores hold.

maria: Prioritization: mark high if we can show >=25% latency improvement and >=95% JSON exact-match.

alex: Proposed schedule:
- Day0: fetch/convert + int8 baseline
- Day2: awq/int4
- Day3: templates + toolcall tests
- Day5: bench + rollout proposal

jiang: tagging infra: @infra-bot request 1xA100 (24h) and 2xA10 spot.

infra-bot: infra-bot: a100-1 allocated (24h); a10-2 spot pending (ETA ~2h). :white_check_mark:

sam: SDK note: include client-side JSON validator and small fuzzing to catch malformed args.

taylor: Streaming nuance: stream final_answer tokens, but buffer tool_call until JSON complete to avoid partial parses.

maria: Action items:
- jiang: run conversion + quant benches, put logs under /bench/zephyr-14b/day0
- sam: author 3 canonical prompts + JSON schemas
- alex: write rollout + canary with fallback to 13B-int8
- taylor: add SDK template + validator

jiang: Day0 quick: conversion hit a shape mismatch in head, fix in PR.

infra-bot: infra-bot: a10-2 spot now live. :rocket:

jiang: Day0 results: int8 p95 token latency 175ms, awq-4 p95 210ms. JSON exact-match: int8 96%, awq-4 92%. Uploading artifacts.

maria: Good. We'll iterate templates to reduce AWQ formatting errors. Sync in tomorrow standup.

alex: I'll capture rollout risks and SLOs. Ping CS on any failing exact-match cases.

sam: Adding fuzz cases to validator suite. Leaving notes about recording quant-type, kernel variant, seq-len distribution in bench metadata.

maria: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after Day2.
